about.title: About Texas Engineered Roofing
text: At Texas Engineered Roofing, every project starts with the same principle: precision matters. Led by a licensed engineer and roofing contractor, our team combines technical expertise with a focus of craftsmanship and customer service exceeding expectations.

Every residential roof we install is hand-nailed which gives us complete control over placement and pressure, ensuring every shingle performs as expected when tested against our unpredictable weather. The majority of our competitors only nail gun which can cause serious issues if not properly calibrated, primarily leading to overdriven nails that tear through shingles.
Texas Engineered Roofing aligns with respected organizations that mirror our dedication to craftsmanship, industry expertise, and the communities we serve.
